item.title: Hacker claims ‘123456’ password let them breach the Danish national registry, accessing 8.8 million records
item.description: The Danish Central Register of Persons (CPF) was breached through the account of an IT and data services business. The hacker claimed that one of the breached accounts was only protected by a 123456 password.

item.title: The MFA Gaps Attackers are Still Exploiting
item.description: Attackers continue exploiting gaps in MFA coverage, using stolen credentials to access VPNs, RDP, and Windows systems that still rely on passwords alone. Specops explains why protecting cloud applications isn t enough and how organizations can close these authentication gaps. [...]
